title: Miriam
lead: The sister of Moses and Aaron, called a prophet, who led Israel's women in song at the sea (Exodus 15:20–21). She is named with her brothers as Israel's leaders (Micah 6:4), and her name lives on as Mary.

sections.b: Miriam is probably the sister who watches baby Moses (Exodus 2:4–8). At the sea she is called a prophet and leads the women in song (Exodus 15:20–21). In Numbers 12 she and Aaron speak against Moses over his Cushite wife and claim that God speaks through them too; she is struck with a skin disease and shut out of the camp for seven days, and the people wait for her (Numbers 12:1–15). She dies at Kadesh (Numbers 20:1), and the next verse says there was no water, which the rabbis connected with a well that traveled with Israel by her merit. Deuteronomy 24:9 recalls her punishment, and Micah 6:4 names her with Moses and Aaron as leaders sent by God.
